story: Label alignment becomes intermittently inconsistent after a roll change while bottle presentation variability is elevated.
truth_boundary: Scenario truth exists only to coordinate synthetic source outputs. It is not commissioned machine truth, OEM guidance, a diagnosis, or evidence about a physical machine.

design_assumptions.intent: Historical maintenance evidence is a first-class ranking input. In this demo, routine troubleshooting-guide interventions are commissioned to the operator by default unless explicitly marked otherwise.

historical_evidence.summary: Four well-documented similar historical cases on this synthetic asset localized to bottle-presentation relationships; three required the same standard approved guide/presentation setup restoration and none required a timing change.
historical_evidence.boundary: Historical pattern strongly informs ranking but does not prove the current root cause or current physical state.

deterministic_interpretation.summary: The verification run remains worse than the synthetic baseline and slightly better than the immediately preceding concern window.
deterministic_interpretation.bounded_finding: Alignment inconsistency persists while presentation-interval variability remains elevated relative to the synthetic baseline.
deterministic_interpretation.standard_change: Restore guide / spacing to the approved marked setup reference
deterministic_interpretation.standard_change_basis: Current visible alignment evidence, elevated presentation variability, unchanged line speed, and 3/4 highly similar CMMS cases with successful standard guide/presentation correction heavily align with this routine operator-friendly change.
deterministic_interpretation.causality_boundary: Strong alignment with a known standard change supports trying that bounded intervention first in this synthetic demo. It still does not prove the present root cause.

ranked_next_options.ranking_semantics: Current evidence alignment, historical CMMS support, and information value only. Rank is not root-cause probability or proof. In this synthetic plant, routine guide interventions are commissioned operator actions by default.
basis: operator reports visible misalignment after a roll change
camera still shows an apparent skew event
presentation-interval variability remains elevated versus the synthetic baseline
line speed is unchanged across baseline, concern, and verification windows
four similar well-maintained CMMS cases localized to bottle-presentation relationships
three similar CMMS cases were resolved by the same standard guide/presentation setup restoration
no similar historical case required a timing change

options.title: Restore guide / spacing to the approved marked setup reference
options.rationale: The detected pattern heavily aligns with the standard guide/presentation correction documented in 3/4 highly similar synthetic CMMS cases, while the current camera and presentation-variability evidence remains compatible with that pattern.
options.historical_support: strong: 3/4 highly similar cases used the same standard approved guide/presentation correction
options.boundary: Perform one bounded standard change only, then run the 5-container verification trial before any other material change. Strong match is not proof of root cause.

options.title: Inspect bottle presentation stability
options.rationale: Current operator, telemetry, camera, and quality evidence still supports presentation-focused observation if the standard setup reference cannot be confidently restored.
options.historical_support: strong: 4/4 similar synthetic CMMS cases localized to presentation relationships
options.boundary: Observe and record. If findings contradict the standard-change pattern, rerank before another material change.

options.title: Repeat the same-condition verification run
options.rationale: A repeat without another material change provides useful repeatability evidence if the operator elects not to apply the top-ranked standard change yet.
options.historical_support: neutral: history favors the standard correction first
options.boundary: No additional material change is introduced. Preserve the same controlled conditions.

options.title: Run the standard temporary reduced-speed diagnostic trial
options.rationale: A rate-sensitivity test may add information, but speed did not change when the concern appeared and three similar historical cases occurred at normal line speed.
options.historical_support: weakens rank: 3 similar synthetic cases occurred at normal line speed
options.boundary: Routine operator-friendly demo action, but only one temporary setting change is made before fresh verification. No real production speed value is defined by this fixture.

options.title: Review label timing / peel geometry and make only the standard guide adjustment if indicated
options.rationale: Current evidence points more strongly toward presentation stability, and none of the four similar synthetic CMMS cases required a timing change.
options.historical_support: deprioritizing: 0/4 similar synthetic cases required timing change
options.boundary: Deprioritized does not mean healthy. If current evidence supports a standard timing or peel adjustment, make only one bounded change and verify.

parameters_notice: All numeric values, historical records, operator permissions, standard changes, and ranked options are synthetic scenario parameters chosen for internal consistency and demo readability. They are not OEM thresholds, commissioned limits, safe operating limits, production recommendations, or proof of root cause.
